instructions: Besides bugs, review for code that works but should not exist or is larger than the behavior needs. The repository rules are in the context files.

rules.rule: Flag violations of the "Keep changes lean" section of AGENTS.md, and name the existing symbol to reuse or show the smaller equivalent.

Flag violations of the "Platform posture" section of AGENTS.md, such as OS version checks or compatibility branches for older Apple platforms, unless the pull request says they were explicitly requested. @available(*, unavailable) on initializers is fine.

Flag new test cases that violate "When to commit tests" in docs/TESTING.md, such as tests that duplicate existing coverage or name no production failure. A test that guards a distinct failure is not a violation just because it could have extended an existing test. If the pull request does not state which failure a new test catches, ask for it.
Flag test synchronization that violates "Test design and evidence" in docs/TESTING.md, such as fixed sleeps or mutable global test state.
